questions.ask: Could you please tell me your date of birth?
And what are the last four digits of the phone number on file?

hints.day_month_swapped: Could you please say your date of birth again, with the month as a word?

lines.opening: Hello, this is Freya Bank's digital assistant calling. We record this call.
lines.robot: I am Freya Bank's digital assistant.
lines.scam: You can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number.
lines.purpose_before_verify: I can only share that once I have confirmed I am speaking with the right person.
lines.no_info: I'm sorry, I do not have that information.
lines.not_talk_once: I understand. This will only take a few minutes.
lines.tp_ask_time: What time would suit, between 10 AM and 7 PM, today or on the next business day?
lines.tp_outside_window: I'm sorry, I can only call back today or on the next business day, between 10 AM and 7 PM. Is there another time that would work?
lines.tp_no_info: I'm sorry, I can only speak with {title} {last_name} directly.
lines.tp_booked: Thank you. We will call back on {date} at {time}.
lines.wrong_number: I'm sorry for the trouble. Thank you for letting me know.
lines.condolence: I am sorry for your loss.
lines.id_intro: Before we continue, I need to ask you two security questions.
lines.id_why: These questions protect your account and make sure I am speaking with the right person.
lines.id_explain: I understand. The questions protect your account, so I can only continue once they are answered. Could you answer them?
lines.id_declined: I understand. I cannot continue without checking your identity.
lines.id_repeat: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you say it again?
lines.id_wrong: That does not match our records. Could you try again?
lines.id_failed: I'm sorry, I could not verify your identity. Please use the Freya Bank mobile app or visit a branch.
lines.disclose_intro: Thank you. I am calling from the collections team about a late payment.
lines.product_line: Your {name} has {amount} past due and is {days} days late.
lines.ask_today: Can you make this payment today?
lines.ask_today_multi: Can you make all of these payments today?
lines.offer_floor_date: I understand. Could you pay {amount} on {date}? The rest stays overdue.
lines.offer_floor: I understand. Could you pay {amount}? The rest stays overdue.
lines.below_floor: I'm sorry, I cannot record an amount that low. Could you pay {amount} instead? The rest stays overdue.
lines.below_floor_again: I'm sorry, I cannot record an amount below {amount}.
lines.date_past: That date has already passed. Which day from today onwards would work for you?
lines.not_business_day: That day is not a business day. Could you pay on {date} instead?
lines.after_deadline: The latest date I can record is {date}. Could you pay on {date}?
lines.vague_ask: Which exact day would that be?
lines.ask_date_for_amount: On which day could you pay {amount}?
lines.repeat_offer: Just to repeat, could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.clamped_note: For your {name}, the latest date I can accept is {date}, so I will use that date.
lines.sms_line: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.
lines.record_failed: I'm sorry, I could not record your promise.
lines.paid_line: Thank you. Payments can take one business day to appear.
lines.dispute_line: I understand. I will make a note of that.
lines.hardship: I'm very sorry to hear that. Would you like me to connect you with our customer support team?
lines.hardship_offer_again: Would you like me to connect you with our customer support team? Please say yes or no.

lines.transfer: I am transferring you now. Please hold.
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.promise_change: You can change it in the mobile app.
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.

assumptions: Brief B is the later, more specific document and says every Brief A rule applies unless a Brief B rule replaces it. The spec follows Brief B, which also covers a single product. Brief B rule 8 replaces Brief A's 'never uses add_note', so notes.enabled is true.
Brief B rule 10 replaces the plain note rule on transfers: on any transfer (restructuring, support, human) no notes are added. Promises that were agreed but not yet recorded are dropped.

Brief B closing rule: with no promise recorded, close as 'paid' only if every product is noted 'paid'. Otherwise close as no_promise with the reason of the first product, in get_account order, whose note is not 'paid'. 'promise' wins if at least one promise was recorded, except on a transfer.
Neither brief names a currency. currency_word uses the default 'dollars'.
Brief A rule 1 requires saying the call is recorded. The opening says 'We record this call.' (active voice), as the spec format requires.

Callback: the brief does not require 'today' to be a business day, so business_days_only is false. The next day must be a business day ('next_business_day'). Window 10:00 to 19:00, both included, and later than now.
Callback max_asks is 2: one more ask after the first time outside the window (rule 7).
Confirm max_asks is 2 (rule 3). Answering a customer's question first does not reset the count.

Identity: date of birth first, then phone_last4, from rule 11. Numeric dates are read day, month, year (dmy). The day_month_swapped hint (the only hint in the tool API enum) asks the customer to repeat the date of birth with the month as a word (rule 13). The retry does not count as a wrong answer, and the full date is needed to call verify_identity again.
Asking what the call is about instead of answering counts as declining (rule 15). Other side questions, such as robot or scam, are not declines.
Floor names 'minimum payment' and 'instalment amount' come from the tool fields minimum_payment and instalment_amount (rule 25). The brief itself just calls it 'the floor'.

Ladder attempt 1 is full_or_floor on the last business day of this week. If today is that day, the engine uses the last business day of next week (rule 30). Attempt 2, late band only, is the floor on the deadline.
Deadlines are counted in business days, so they always fall on a business day. deadline_adjust keeps the default previous_business_day.
The brief says nothing about asking 'anything else' after a promise. The default ask_anything_else = true is kept.
After a recorded promise, sms_line uses the exact sentence from rule 38.
promise_change uses rule 36: the promise can be changed in the mobile app.
Queue mapping from the tool API: restructuring -> 'restructuring', human -> 'general', support -> 'support'.
Saying 'I don't want to talk' twice closes as no_promise/refused after verification and as not_verified/declined before it (rule 45).

Hardship (rule 32) comes before persuasion and restructuring. If the customer declines support, the call closes as no_promise/hardship with a hardship note for that product. A date or amount the customer offers is still recorded under sections 7 and 8.
